title: hussain jeet gaye
body:
sada ye deta hai sajda-hussain jeet gaye
bachaake deen nabi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok pe jaisi hi sar buland hua
ajeeb shaan se maqtal me mustafa ne kaha
wo dekho fatima zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke lehje me qutbaat to sunaane do
zara si der hai zainab ko shaam aane do
yazeed qud ye kahega
<<DIVIDER>>
qareebe qaanae parwardigaar ja to sahi
nazar se bughz ke parde zara hata to sahi
likha hai bar sare kaaba
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ho teere-o kama'n ho, ya naiza-o qanjar
sitam ki tegh ho bhaale ho dhaal ho ke tabar
zabaa'n pe sab ki yahi tha
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya jo nehr pe qabza ali ke dilbar ne
salaam pyaas ko badhkar kiya samandar ne
pukaarne laga darya
<<DIVIDER>>
ameere shaam kahan ab teri hukoomat hai
mere hussain ke qadmo pe laashe baiyat hai
uthaale aake janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
aza'n me lehjae akbar ka is qadar tha asar
abhi to jang ka aaghaz bhi nahi hai magar
zameere hur ka hai daawa
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki tarjuma sajjad ki zubaan hui
har ek simt se bewaqt jab azaan hui
pukaari saanie zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aqse faatahe qaibar ye bezubaan nahi
aye hurmala tujhe maloom iski shaan nahi
abhi kahega ye bacha
<<DIVIDER>>
bigaada kya hai takallum hamara fatwo ne
zamana goonj raha hai sadaae maatam se
gali gali me hai charcha
